executive_summary: OFAC added 86 entities and individuals to the SDN list, primarily targeting those involved in illicit drug trafficking in Mexico. One entity was removed from the list. The additions highlight the ongoing efforts to disrupt and dismantle drug trafficking organizations.

notable_entities.name: Juan Carlos GONZALEZ
notable_entities.significance: Key figure in Mexican drug trafficking organization

notable_entities.name: Zepeda Rodriguez Jorge
notable_entities.significance: Involved in illicit drug trafficking activities in Mexico

notable_entities.name: GONZALEZ RAMIREZ Francisco Noe
notable_entities.significance: Alias 'El F1', associated with Mexican drug trafficking

risk_implications.description: The additions to the SDN list pose a significant risk to organizations involved in international trade, particularly those with ties to Mexico
The updated list may impact financial institutions and their ability to detect and prevent money laundering activities related to drug trafficking

program_highlights.note: The program targets individuals and entities involved in illicit drug trafficking, with a focus on Mexico
The program targets Specially Designated Global Terrorists, including those involved in drug trafficking

compliance_recommendations: Conduct thorough due diligence on all business partners and clients, particularly those with ties to Mexico
Implement robust anti-money laundering (AML) and know-your-customer (KYC) procedures to detect and prevent illicit activities
Regularly review and update sanctions lists to ensure compliance with OFAC regulations
